body:
Adds `Chen2022_small_ice_terminal_velocity_max` (1.5 m/s), the asymptotic bound on the bulk cloud ice terminal velocity in the CloudMicrophysics 1-moment scheme, next to the existing bounds for rain (`Chen2022_rain_terminal_velocity_max`) and large ice (`Chen2022_large_ice_terminal_velocity_max`).

CloudMicrophysics applies the bound in https://github.com/CliMA/CloudMicrophysics.jl/pull/861, where `Chen2022VelTypeSmallIce.v_max` is a struct default of the same value. Once this is released, the entry can be mapped to `v_max` there.

Bumps the version to 1.3.14.
title: Add the cloud ice terminal velocity bound
